006784: // The bits of `field` that lie in one piece of its span, as the half-open
006785: // range [`low`, `high`) of span bit positions. Empty when the piece holds none
006786: // of them, which no piece of a span that is exactly the field's bytes does,
006787: // but a caller that walks pieces should not have to know that.
006788: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_ir_bit_field_piece_bits(IrField const* field, IrFieldAccessPiece piece, u32* low, u32* high)
006789: {
006790:     u32 piece_low = (u32)piece.offset * 8;
006791:     u32 piece_high = piece_low + (u32)piece.size * 8;
006792:     u32 field_high = field->bit_offset + field->bit_width;
006793:     *low = BUSTER_MAX(piece_low, field->bit_offset);
006794:     *high = BUSTER_MIN(piece_high, field_high);
006795: }
006796: 
006797: // A packed bit-field the aggregate left no single storage unit for is read one
006798: // piece at a time and reassembled: each piece contributes the bits of its own
006799: // byte range that belong to the field, shifted down to the field's low bit.
006800: // The assembly runs at sixty-four bits, which covers every bit-field there is,
006801: // and the result narrows to the declared type on the way out -- the same shape
006802: // the single-unit extraction has, with the load replaced by a sum of loads.
006803: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_split_bit_field_load(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId place, IrField* field, IrTypeId type, u64 access_size,
006804:                                                            IrSourceRange source)
006805: {
006806:     IrFieldAccessPiece pieces[IR_FIELD_ACCESS_PIECE_CAPACITY];
006807:     u32 piece_count = ir_field_access_pieces(access_size, pieces);
006808:     IrType* value_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type);
006809:     IrTypeId wide_type = c_ir_unsigned_type_of_size(builder, 8);
006810:     IrValueId address = piece_count && value_type && wide_type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID
006811:                             ? c_ir_emit_bit_field_storage_address(builder, place, source)
006812:                             : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
006813:     if (address.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
006814:     {
006815:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
006816:     }
006817:     CToken token = {0};
006818:     IrValueId assembled = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
006819:     for (u32 index = 0; index < piece_count; index += 1)
006820:     {
006821:         u32 low = 0;
006822:         u32 high = 0;
006823:         c_ir_bit_field_piece_bits(field, pieces[index], &low, &high);
006824:         if (low >= high)
006825:         {
006826:             continue;
006827:         }
006828:         IrTypeId piece_type = c_ir_unsigned_type_of_size(builder, pieces[index].size);
006829:         IrValueId piece_place =
006830:             piece_type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? c_ir_emit_bit_field_piece_place(builder, address, pieces[index].offset, piece_type, source)
006831:                                                          : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
006832:         IrValueId loaded = piece_place.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? c_ir_emit_load_place_raw(builder, piece_place, piece_type, source)
006833:                                                                         : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
006834:         IrValueId part = loaded.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? c_ir_emit_cast(builder, loaded, wide_type, source) : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
006835:         if (part.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
006836:         {
006837:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
006838:         }
006839:         if (low > (u32)pieces[index].offset * 8)
006840:         {
006841:             IrValueId shift = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, low - (u32)pieces[index].offset * 8, false, token, wide_type);
006842:             part = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, part, shift, wide_type, IR_BINARY_UNSIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT, source);
006843:         }
006844:         u64 mask = high - low == 64 ? UINT64_MAX : ((u64)1 << (high - low)) - 1;
006845:         IrValueId mask_value = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, mask, false, token, wide_type);
006846:         part = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, part, mask_value, wide_type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_AND, source);
006847:         if (low > field->bit_offset)
006848:         {
006849:             IrValueId shift = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, low - field->bit_offset, false, token, wide_type);
006850:             part = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, part, shift, wide_type, IR_BINARY_SHIFT_LEFT, source);
006851:         }
006852:         assembled = assembled.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID
006853:                         ? part
006854:                         : c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, assembled, part, wide_type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_OR, source);
006855:         if (assembled.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
006856:         {
006857:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
006858:         }
006859:     }
006860:     if (assembled.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
006861:     {
006862:         return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
006863:     }
006864:     // The sign lives at the field's own top bit, so it is stretched from
006865:     // there rather than from the assembly width; an unsigned field already
006866:     // has zeroes above it from the masks.
006867:     if (value_type->is_signed && field->bit_width < 64)
006868:     {
006869:         IrTypeId signed_type = c_ir_builder_scalar_type(builder, C_TYPE_LONG_LONG);
006870:         IrType* signed_value_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, signed_type);
006871:         if (!signed_value_type || signed_value_type->bit_width != 64)
006872:         {
006873:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
006874:         }
006875:         IrValueId shift = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 64 - field->bit_width, false, token, signed_type);
006876:         assembled = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, assembled, signed_type, source);
006877:         assembled = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, assembled, shift, signed_type, IR_BINARY_SHIFT_LEFT, source);
006878:         assembled = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, assembled, shift, signed_type, IR_BINARY_SIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT, source);
006879:     }
006880:     IrValueId result = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, assembled, type, source);
006881:     c_ir_mark_unsigned_bit_field_value(builder, result, field);
006882:     return result;
006883: }

006885: // The write half of the same split: every piece keeps the bits that are not
006886: // the field's and takes the field's from the value. A piece the field fills
006887: // completely needs no read at all.
006888: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_emit_split_bit_field_store(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId place, IrField* field, IrValueId value, u64 access_size,
006889:                                                        IrSourceRange source)
006890: {
006891:     IrFieldAccessPiece pieces[IR_FIELD_ACCESS_PIECE_CAPACITY];
006892:     u32 piece_count = ir_field_access_pieces(access_size, pieces);
006893:     IrTypeId wide_type = c_ir_unsigned_type_of_size(builder, 8);
006894:     IrValueId wide = piece_count && wide_type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? c_ir_emit_cast(builder, value, wide_type, source) : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
006895:     IrValueId address = wide.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? c_ir_emit_bit_field_storage_address(builder, place, source) : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
006896:     if (address.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
006897:     {
006898:         return false;
006899:     }
006900:     CToken token = {0};
006901:     for (u32 index = 0; index < piece_count; index += 1)
006902:     {
006903:         u32 low = 0;
006904:         u32 high = 0;
006905:         c_ir_bit_field_piece_bits(field, pieces[index], &low, &high);
006906:         if (low >= high)
006907:         {
006908:             continue;
006909:         }
006910:         u32 piece_low = (u32)pieces[index].offset * 8;
006911:         u32 piece_bits = (u32)pieces[index].size * 8;
006912:         IrTypeId piece_type = c_ir_unsigned_type_of_size(builder, pieces[index].size);
006913:         IrValueId piece_place =
006914:             piece_type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? c_ir_emit_bit_field_piece_place(builder, address, pieces[index].offset, piece_type, source)
006915:                                                          : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
006916:         if (piece_place.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
006917:         {
006918:             return false;
006919:         }
006920:         IrValueId part = wide;
006921:         if (low > field->bit_offset)
006922:         {
006923:             IrValueId shift = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, low - field->bit_offset, false, token, wide_type);
006924:             part = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, part, shift, wide_type, IR_BINARY_UNSIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT, source);
006925:         }
006926:         u64 value_mask = high - low == 64 ? UINT64_MAX : ((u64)1 << (high - low)) - 1;
006927:         IrValueId mask_value = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, value_mask, false, token, wide_type);
006928:         part = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, part, mask_value, wide_type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_AND, source);
006929:         if (low > piece_low)
006930:         {
006931:             IrValueId shift = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, low - piece_low, false, token, wide_type);
006932:             part = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, part, shift, wide_type, IR_BINARY_SHIFT_LEFT, source);
006933:         }
006934:         part = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, part, piece_type, source);
006935:         if (part.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
006936:         {
006937:             return false;
006938:         }
006939:         if (high - low != piece_bits)
006940:         {
006941:             u64 storage_mask = ((high - low == 64 ? UINT64_MAX : ((u64)1 << (high - low)) - 1) << (low - piece_low));
006942:             IrValueId clear = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, ~storage_mask, false, token, piece_type);
006943:             IrValueId current = c_ir_emit_load_place_raw(builder, piece_place, piece_type, source);
006944:             current = current.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID
006945:                           ? c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, current, clear, piece_type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_AND, source)
006946:                           : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
006947:             part = current.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, current, part, piece_type, IR_BINARY_INTEGER_BITWISE_OR, source)
006948:                                                              : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
006949:             if (part.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
006950:             {
006951:                 return false;
006952:             }
006953:         }
006954:         if (!c_ir_emit_store_place(builder, piece_place, piece_type, part, source))
006955:         {
006956:             return false;
006957:         }
006958:     }
006959:     return true;
006960: }

006962: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_load_place(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId place, IrTypeId type, IrSourceRange source)
006963: {
006964:     // C 6.3.2.1p4: a function designator is converted to a pointer to the
006965:     // function; there is nothing to load out of one. The place reaches here
006966:     // when the name resolves to an entity rather than to a call — a
006967:     // block-scope `extern void sighandler(int);` declares such a name, and
006968:     // sbase's make then stores it in a `struct sigaction`.
006969:     IrType* designated_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type);
006970:     if (designated_type && designated_type->kind == IR_TYPE_FUNCTION)
006971:     {
006972:         return c_ir_emit_address_of_place(builder, place, type, source);
006973:     }
006974:     IrField* field = c_ir_bit_field_from_place(builder, place);
006975:     IrType* value_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type);
